title: Mixer varispeed bridge, drift trim and resync on clock jumps (allocation-free)
description:
## Intent
Stay on the beat between a tempo change and the re-warped arrangement, absorb device drift, and re-align after clock jumps, using the strategy decided in `design/link.md` (planned: varispeed bridge, rate trim, resync threshold). Makes the bridge, drift and jump scenarios of apricitus-91ed40 and apricitus-ba8ee6 green.

## Steps
1. `crates/apricity-engine/src/arrangement.rs`: a fractional-rate read (`mix_into` at a rate, with interpolation), allocation-free.
2. `mixer.rs`: rate = clock tempo / arrangement tempo × trim; trim bounded (proposal ±0.1%); an error beyond the threshold (proposal 20 ms) re-aligns with the 5 ms crossfade.
3. Unit tests for the interpolated read (a sine read at 0.75 and 1.25 keeps its frequency ratio), for trim convergence, and for the jump case.

## Verify
`cargo test -p apricity-engine` (bridge, drift and jump scenarios green; allocation guard zero).

Commit: `feat(<this task id>): varispeed bridge and drift trim`.

## Protocol
Specs first, watched red; log decisions, problems and outcomes with `kbs comment`; run Verify and paste the tail. Every Bash call starts `export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH && cd /Users/home/Projects/Apricity`; cargo with `CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 RUST_TEST_THREADS=2` under `safe-run.sh --`. Never change dependencies to make a build pass. Sub-agents never commit, push or close.
